title: Premium Showcase Design Token
description: Design token schema for the premium-showcase category (Tesla / Apple Vision Pro / Hermès / Aston Martin / Bang & Olufsen style). Cinema-led, photography-first, editorial typography. Sits beside schema/design-token.schema.json (Layer 2 framework-agnostic base) and adds premium-showcase-specific keys. Used by ps-1-tesla-cinematic / ps-2-apple-vision-pro verification projects.

namespace.description: Tailwind utility class namespace. Convention: 'ps-auto-' for premium-showcase (shared with native-app pattern).

description.description: Human-readable summary of this token set

theme.description: Theme mode. Tesla uses OLED dark (#000 base), Apple Vision Pro uses light (#FFF base) — premium-showcase is the only category where theme varies per subproject.

reference_brands.description: 3-5 brands whose visual language inspired this token set (e.g. ['Tesla', 'Aston Martin', 'Bang & Olufsen']).

colors.description: Color tokens. Premium-showcase uses semantic naming (bg / surface-N / text-primary / accent) rather than the Layer 2 surface-1/2/3 numeric ladder.

fonts.description: Three-axis font system. premium-showcase defaults to display=Serif (editorial) + body=Sans (readable) + mono=Mono (specs).

display.description: Editorial Serif stack (Tiempos / GT Sectra / SF Pro Display)

body.description: Readability Sans stack (Söhne / SF Pro Text / Inter)

mono.description: Mono numerics (GT America Mono / SF Mono / ui-monospace)

fontSize.description: Type scale. hero / section-title / spec / body / eyebrow.

letterSpacing.description: Letter-spacing scale. premium-showcase uses tight / tighter (-0.035em / -0.045em) for editorial large titles.

lineHeight.description: Line-height scale. tight / snug for headings, body for prose, relaxed for ultrawide paragraphs.

spacing.description: Spacing scale. section-y is intentionally wide (clamp 96-200px) for premium whitespace.

borderRadius.description: Radius scale. Pill (980px) used for Apple-style primary buttons.

shadows.description: Shadow tokens. Glass / glow / spatial-elevated are category-specific.

blur.description: Backdrop-blur for glass / spatial UI. Apple Vision Pro uses 20-32px glass blur.

easing.description: Easing curves. expo-out (cubic-bezier 0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) is the premium-showcase standard for slow editorial easing.

duration.description: Animation duration scale. cinema is 1100-1200ms (premium-showcase exclusive).

maxWidth.description: Container widths. content (980px) is editorial reading width; wide (1240px) is feature-row; bleed (1440px) is hero.
